title: Humans Correct Their Judgments Through Debate, but Weaker AI Models Do Not
abstract: arXiv:2610.28539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How can we effectively oversee AI systems that surpass human intelligence? AI Safety via Debate proposes that two AI systems argue opposing positions and a judge, either a human or a weaker model, decides which is correct. By facilitating supervisors in providing high-quality training signals, debate aims to encourage truthful and safe behavior from AI systems whose capabilities exceed our own. However, human judgment is not neutral: people often rely on biases which advanced AI systems may learn to exploit. Drawing on insights from collective intelligence and social cognition, this paper investigates whether debate can guide human and LLM supervisors toward the truth despite their prior beliefs. We evaluate several protocol configurations. We also explore setups inspired by the wisdom of the crowd such as the number and diversity of judges, as well as interaction mechanisms including deliberation and voting. translated_title: 人类能通过辩论纠正自己的判断，但较弱的AI模型却不能
translated_abstract: 我们如何有效地监督那些超越人类智能的AI系统？“通过辩论实现AI安全”提出让两个AI系统就对立立场展开辩论，由裁判（可以是人类或较弱的模型）来判定哪一方正确。通过帮助监督者提供高质量的训练信号，辩论旨在促使能力超越我们自身的AI系统表现出真实、安全的行为。然而，人类的判断并非中立：人们常常依赖各种偏见，而先进的AI系统可能学会利用这些偏见。借鉴集体智能与社会认知领域的研究见解，本文探究了辩论能否引导人类监督者和大语言模型监督者克服先验信念、走向真相。我们评估了多种协议配置，还探索了受群体智慧启发的设置，例如裁判的数量与多样性，以及审议和投票等互动机制。总体而言，我们发现辩论能够帮助人类纠正判断、趋向真相，但作为裁判的较弱AI模型却无法通过辩论纠正自身判断。
tldr: 研究表明，辩论能帮助人类监督者克服偏见、纠正判断并走向真相，但较弱的AI模型作为裁判时却无法通过辩论纠正自己的判断。
en_tdlr: This study shows that debate helps human supervisors overcome biases and correct their judgments toward the truth, but weaker AI models acting as judges fail to correct their judgments through debate.
